HSBC aims to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We help customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs around the world.

The Employee Workplace Solution Premier Acquisition Manager focuses on acquiring and onboarding Premier customers, achieving sales targets, providing tailored financial solutions and building lasting relationships. It also involves managing leads, referrals and complaints, maintaining application quality and ensuring full compliance while delivering excellent customer experience.
q: Relevant wealth and personal banking knowledge
Strong understanding of WPB products, propositions and services.
Ability to explain products clearly and match them to customer needs.
Experience with affluent or high-net-worth customers
Proven experience serving, advising or selling to high-net-worth individuals.
Ability to build trust and develop long-term customer relationships.
Track record of achieving sales or acquisition targets.
Knowledge of networking strategies, prospecting and identifying new business opportunities.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills.
Ability to use a need-based selling approach and provide personalized solutions.
Understanding of competitor activity and market propositions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and improve customer value.
Commitment to customer service, internal controls, regulatory requirements and money-laundering deterrence standards.
Excellent organization, reliability and ability to work independently and collaboratively, including seamless referral and handover of customers to specialist teams.
